Integration · Group 5 of 8

Protocol-compatible TCP client

Five named cases from the tracked correctness inventory, kept on one focused page.

5 exact casesInventory source: test suite

Exact current cases

  1. connects without loading node-ipc in the peer
  2. delivers a neutral object frame to the node-ipc server
  3. delivers a neutral false payload to the node-ipc server
  4. delivers a neutral zero payload to the node-ipc server
  5. decodes a node-ipc reply with only the wire contract
Neutral peer has a narrow meaning.

The peer follows the framed wire contract without importing node-ipc. These cases demonstrate protocol compatibility; they are not proof of an implementation in another programming language.
